import logging
import json
import os
import re
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import defaultdict, deque
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from enum import Enum
import hashlib

class EventSeverity(Enum):
    INFO = "INFO"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
    HIGH = "HIGH"

class EventCategory(Enum):
    AUTHENTICATION = "AUTHENTICATION"
    AUTHORIZATION = "AUTHORIZATION"
    FILE_ACCESS = "FILE_ACCESS"
    NETWORK = "NETWORK"
    PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION = "PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION"
    SYSTEM = "SYSTEM"
    APPLICATION = "APPLICATION"

@dataclass
class SecurityEvent:
    timestamp: str
    event_id: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    source: str
    user: Optional[str]
    action: str
    resource: Optional[str]
    ip_address: Optional[str]
    details: Dict[str, Any]
    status: str

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    def to_json(self) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), default=str)

class SecurityLogger:
    def __init__(self, log_file: str = "security_events.log", max_file_size: int = 10485760):
        self.log_file = log_file
        self.max_file_size = max_file_size
        self.logger = self._setup_logger()
        self.event_counter = 0

    def _setup_logger(self) -> logging.Logger:
        logger = logging.getLogger("SecurityLogger")
        logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

        if not logger.handlers:
            handler = logging.FileHandler(self.log_file)
            formatter = logging.Formatter('%(message)s')
            handler.setFormatter(formatter)
            logger.addHandler(handler)

            console_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
            console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
            logger.addHandler(console_handler)

        return logger

    def _generate_event_id(self) -> str:
        self.event_counter += 1
        timestamp = datetime.now().isoformat()
        unique_string = f"{timestamp}-{self.event_counter}-{os.getpid()}"
        return hashlib.sha256(unique_string.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

    def _rotate_log_if_needed(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.log_file) and os.path.getsize(self.log_file) > self.max_file_size:
            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            rotated_file = f"{self.log_file}.{timestamp}"
            os.rename(self.log_file, rotated_file)

    def log_event(self, category: EventCategory, severity: EventSeverity,
                  source: str, action: str, user: Optional[str] = None,
                  resource: Optional[str] = None, ip_address: Optional[str] = None,
                  details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, status: str = "SUCCESS") -> SecurityEvent:
        self._rotate_log_if_needed()

        event = SecurityEvent(
            timestamp=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            event_id=self._generate_event_id(),
            category=category.value,
            severity=severity.value,
            source=source,
            user=user,
            action=action,
            resource=resource,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            details=details or {},
            status=status
        )

        self.logger.info(event.to_json())
        return event

    def log_authentication(self, user: str, success: bool, ip_address: str,
                          method: str = "password", details: Optional[Dict] = None) -> SecurityEvent:
        severity = EventSeverity.INFO if success else EventSeverity.WARNING
        status = "SUCCESS" if success else "FAILURE"
        action = "LOGIN" if success else "LOGIN_FAILED"

        return self.log_event(
            category=EventCategory.AUTHENTICATION,
            severity=severity,
            source="auth_service",
            action=action,
            user=user,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            details={"method": method, **(details or {})},
            status=status
        )

    def log_file_access(self, user: str, file_path: str, operation: str,
                       success: bool, ip_address: Optional[str] = None) -> SecurityEvent:
        severity = EventSeverity.INFO if success else EventSeverity.WARNING
        if not success and "denied" in operation.lower():
            severity = EventSeverity.HIGH

        return self.log_event(
            category=EventCategory.FILE_ACCESS,
            severity=severity,
            source="file_system",
            action=operation,
            user=user,
            resource=file_path,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            status="SUCCESS" if success else "DENIED"
        )

    def log_privilege_escalation(self, user: str, from_role: str, to_role: str,
                                authorized: bool, ip_address: Optional[str] = None) -> SecurityEvent:
        severity = EventSeverity.INFO if authorized else EventSeverity.CRITICAL

        return self.log_event(
            category=EventCategory.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION,
            severity=severity,
            source="rbac_system",
            action="ROLE_CHANGE",
            user=user,
            details={"from_role": from_role, "to_role": to_role, "authorized": authorized},
            ip_address=ip_address,
            status="SUCCESS" if authorized else "UNAUTHORIZED"
        )

class SecurityMonitor:
    def __init__(self, logger: SecurityLogger, window_minutes: int = 5,
                 brute_force_threshold: int = 5):
        self.logger = logger
        self.window_minutes = window_minutes
        self.brute_force_threshold = brute_force_threshold
        self.failed_attempts: Dict[str, deque] = defaultdict(deque)
        self.alert_handlers: List[Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None]] = []
        self.suspicious_patterns = {
            "brute_force": self._detect_brute_force,
            "privilege_escalation": self._detect_privilege_escalation,
            "unusual_hours": self._detect_unusual_hours,
            "rapid_file_access": self._detect_rapid_file_access
        }

    def add_alert_handler(self, handler: Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None]):
        self.alert_handlers.append(handler)

    def _detect_brute_force(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if event.category == EventCategory.AUTHENTICATION.value and event.status == "FAILURE":
            key = f"{event.user}:{event.ip_address}"
            now = datetime.now()
            self.failed_attempts[key].append(now)

            cutoff = now - timedelta(minutes=self.window_minutes)
            while self.failed_attempts[key] and self.failed_attempts[key][0] < cutoff:
                self.failed_attempts[key].popleft()

            if len(self.failed_attempts[key]) >= self.brute_force_threshold:
                return {
                    "alert_type": "BRUTE_FORCE_DETECTED",
                    "severity": "CRITICAL",
                    "user": event.user,
                    "ip_address": event.ip_address,
                    "attempt_count": len(self.failed_attempts[key]),
                    "time_window": f"{self.window_minutes} minutes",
                    "timestamp": now.isoformat()
                }
        return None

    def _detect_privilege_escalation(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if event.category == EventCategory.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION.value:
            if event.status == "UNAUTHORIZED":
                return {
                    "alert_type": "UNAUTHORIZED_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION",
                    "severity": "CRITICAL",
                    "user": event.user,
                    "details": event.details,
                    "timestamp": event.timestamp
                }
            elif event.details.get("to_role") in ["admin", "root", "superuser"]:
                return {
                    "alert_type": "HIGH_PRIVILEGE_GRANTED",
                    "severity": "WARNING",
                    "user": event.user,
                    "details": event.details,
                    "timestamp": event.timestamp
                }
        return None

    def _detect_unusual_hours(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        try:
            event_time = datetime.fromisoformat(event.timestamp)
            hour = event_time.hour
            if hour < 6 or hour > 22:
                if event.severity in [EventSeverity.WARNING.value, EventSeverity.CRITICAL.value]:
                    return {
                        "alert_type": "UNUSUAL_HOURS_ACTIVITY",
                        "severity": "WARNING",
                        "user": event.user,
                        "hour": hour,
                        "action": event.action,
                        "timestamp": event.timestamp
                    }
        except ValueError:
            pass
        return None

    def _detect_rapid_file_access(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if event.category == EventCategory.FILE_ACCESS.value:
            sensitive_patterns = [r"/etc/passwd", r"/etc/shadow", r"\.ssh/", r"\.env$", r"config\.php"]
            if event.resource:
                for pattern in sensitive_patterns:
                    if re.search(pattern, event.resource):
                        return {
                            "alert_type": "SENSITIVE_FILE_ACCESS",
                            "severity": "HIGH",
                            "user": event.user,
                            "resource": event.resource,
                            "action": event.action,
                            "timestamp": event.timestamp
                        }
        return None

    def analyze_event(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        alerts = []
        for pattern_name, detector in self.suspicious_patterns.items():
            alert = detector(event)
            if alert:
                alerts.append(alert)
                self._trigger_alerts(alert)
        return alerts

    def _trigger_alerts(self, alert: Dict[str, Any]):
        for handler in self.alert_handlers:
            try:
                handler(alert)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error in alert handler: {e}")

    def monitor_event(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        alerts = self.analyze_event(event)
        return {
            "event_id": event.event_id,
            "alerts_generated": len(alerts),
            "alerts": alerts,
            "monitored_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
        }

class SecurityDashboard:
    def __init__(self, log_file: str = "security_events.log"):
        self.log_file = log_file
        self.stats = {
            "total_events": 0,
            "by_severity": defaultdict(int),
            "by_category": defaultdict(int),
            "recent_alerts": deque(maxlen=100)
        }

    def parse_log_file(self, file_path: Optional[str] = None) -> List[SecurityEvent]:
        path = file_path or self.log_file
        events = []
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            return events

        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    try:
                        data = json.loads(line)
                        event = SecurityEvent(**data)
                        events.append(event)
                        self._update_stats(event)
                    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                        continue
        return events

    def _update_stats(self, event: SecurityEvent):
        self.stats["total_events"] += 1
        self.stats["by_severity"][event.severity] += 1
        self.stats["by_category"][event.category] += 1

    def generate_report(self, events: Optional[List[SecurityEvent]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if events is None:
            events = self.parse_log_file()

        critical_events = [e for e in events if e.severity == EventSeverity.CRITICAL.value]
        failed_auths = [e for e in events if e.category == EventCategory.AUTHENTICATION.value and e.status == "FAILURE"]

        return {
            "report_generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "total_events": len(events),
            "critical_events": len(critical_events),
            "failed_authentications": len(failed_auths),
            "severity_breakdown": dict(self.stats["by_severity"]),
            "category_breakdown": dict(self.stats["by_category"]),
            "top_users_by_activity": self._get_top_users(events),
            "recent_critical": [e.to_dict() for e in critical_events[-5:]]
        }

    def _get_top_users(self, events: List[SecurityEvent], limit: int = 5) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        user_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for event in events:
            if event.user:
                user_counts[event.user] += 1

        sorted_users = sorted(user_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:limit]
        return [{"user": user, "event_count": count} for user, count in sorted_users]

def create_security_system(log_file: str = "security_events.log") -> tuple:
    logger = SecurityLogger(log_file=log_file)
    monitor = SecurityMonitor(logger=logger)
    dashboard = SecurityDashboard(log_file=log_file)

    def console_alert_handler(alert: Dict[str, Any]):
        print(f"[ALERT] {alert['alert_type']}: {alert.get('severity', 'UNKNOWN')} - {alert}")

    monitor.add_alert_handler(console_alert_handler)

    return logger, monitor, dashboard

def simulate_security_events(logger: SecurityLogger, monitor: SecurityMonitor, count: int = 10):
    import random

    users = ["admin", "user1", "user2", "guest", "root"]
    ips = ["192.168.1.100", "10.0.0.5", "203.0.113.45", "172.16.0.1"]
    files = ["/etc/passwd", "/var/log/auth.log", "/home/user/document.txt", "/etc/shadow", "/app/config.env"]

    for i in range(count):
        user = random.choice(users)
        ip = random.choice(ips)

        event_type = random.choice(["auth", "file", "privilege", "network"])

        if event_type == "auth":
            success = random.random() > 0.3
            event = logger.log_authentication(user, success, ip, method="password")
            monitor.monitor_event(event)

        elif event_type == "file":
            file_path = random.choice(files)
            success = random.random() > 0.2
            event = logger.log_file_access(user, file_path, "READ", success, ip)
            monitor.monitor_event(event)

        elif event_type == "privilege":
            roles = ["user", "admin", "root", "guest"]
            from_role = random.choice(roles)
            to_role = random.choice([r for r in roles if r != from_role])
            authorized = random.random() > 0.7
            event = logger.log_privilege_escalation(user, from_role, to_role, authorized, ip)
            monitor.monitor_event(event)

        time.sleep(0.1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    logger, monitor, dashboard = create_security_system()
    print("Security monitoring system initialized")
    print(f"Logging to: {logger.log_file}")

    simulate_security_events(logger, monitor, count=20)

    events = dashboard.parse_log_file()
    report = dashboard.generate_report(events)
    print("\nSecurity Report:")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, default=str))

            if event.status == "UNAUTHORIZED":
                return {
                    "alert_type": "UNAUTHORIZED_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION",
                    "severity": "CRITICAL",
                    "user": event.user,
                    "details": event.details,
                    "timestamp": event.timestamp
                }
            elif event.details.get("to_role") in ["admin", "root", "superuser"]:
                return {
                    "alert_type": "HIGH_PRIVILEGE_GRANTED",
                    "severity": "WARNING",
                    "user": event.user,
                    "details": event.details,
                    "timestamp": event.timestamp
                }
        return None

    def _detect_unusual_hours(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        try:
            event_time = datetime.fromisoformat(event.timestamp)
            hour = event_time.hour
            if hour < 6 or hour > 22:
                if event.severity in [EventSeverity.WARNING.value, EventSeverity.CRITICAL.value]:
                    return {
                        "alert_type": "UNUSUAL_HOURS_ACTIVITY",
                        "severity": "WARNING",
                        "user": event.user,
                        "hour": hour,
                        "action": event.action,
                        "timestamp": event.timestamp
                    }
        except ValueError:
            pass
        return None

    def _detect_rapid_file_access(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if event.category == EventCategory.FILE_ACCESS.value:
            sensitive_patterns = [r"/etc/passwd", r"/etc/shadow", r"\.ssh/", r"\.env$", r"config\.php"]
            if event.resource:
                for pattern in sensitive_patterns:
                    if re.search(pattern, event.resource):
                        return {
                            "alert_type": "SENSITIVE_FILE_ACCESS",
                            "severity": "HIGH",
                            "user": event.user,
                            "resource": event.resource,
                            "action": event.action,
                            "timestamp": event.timestamp
                        }
        return None

    def analyze_event(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        alerts = []
        for pattern_name, detector in self.suspicious_patterns.items():
            alert = detector(event)
            if alert:
                alerts.append(alert)
                self._trigger_alerts(alert)
        return alerts

    def _trigger_alerts(self, alert: Dict[str, Any]):
        for handler in self.alert_handlers:
            try:
                handler(alert)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error in alert handler: {e}")

    def monitor_event(self, event: SecurityEvent) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        alerts = self.analyze_event(event)
        return {
            "event_id": event.event_id,
            "alerts_generated": len(alerts),
            "alerts": alerts,
            "monitored_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
        }

class SecurityDashboard:
    def __init__(self, log_file: str = "security_events.log"):
        self.log_file = log_file
        self.stats = {
            "total_events": 0,
            "by_severity": defaultdict(int),
            "by_category": defaultdict(int),
            "recent_alerts": deque(maxlen=100)
        }

    def parse_log_file(self, file_path: Optional[str] = None) -> List[SecurityEvent]:
        path = file_path or self.log_file
        events = []
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            return events

        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    try:
                        data = json.loads(line)
                        event = SecurityEvent(**data)
                        events.append(event)
                        self._update_stats(event)
                    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                        continue
        return events

    def _update_stats(self, event: SecurityEvent):
        self.stats["total_events"] += 1
        self.stats["by_severity"][event.severity] += 1
        self.stats["by_category"][event.category] += 1

    def generate_report(self, events: Optional[List[SecurityEvent]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if events is None:
            events = self.parse_log_file()

        critical_events = [e for e in events if e.severity == EventSeverity.CRITICAL.value]
        failed_auths = [e for e in events if e.category == EventCategory.AUTHENTICATION.value and e.status == "FAILURE"]

        return {
            "report_generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "total_events": len(events),
            "critical_events": len(critical_events),
            "failed_authentications": len(failed_auths),
            "severity_breakdown": dict(self.stats["by_severity"]),
            "category_breakdown": dict(self.stats["by_category"]),
            "top_users_by_activity": self._get_top_users(events),
            "recent_critical": [e.to_dict() for e in critical_events[-5:]]
        }

    def _get_top_users(self, events: List[SecurityEvent], limit: int = 5) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        user_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for event in events:
            if event.user:
                user_counts[event.user] += 1

        sorted_users = sorted(user_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:limit]
        return [{"user": user, "event_count": count} for user, count in sorted_users]

def create_security_system(log_file: str = "security_events.log") -> tuple:
    logger = SecurityLogger(log_file=log_file)
    monitor = SecurityMonitor(logger=logger)
    dashboard = SecurityDashboard(log_file=log_file)

    def console_alert_handler(alert: Dict[str, Any]):
        print(f"[ALERT] {alert['alert_type']}: {alert.get('severity', 'UNKNOWN')} - {alert}")

    monitor.add_alert_handler(console_alert_handler)

    return logger, monitor, dashboard

def simulate_security_events(logger: SecurityLogger, monitor: SecurityMonitor, count: int = 10):
    import random

    users = ["admin", "user1", "user2", "guest", "root"]
    ips = ["192.168.1.100", "10.0.0.5", "203.0.113.45", "172.16.0.1"]
    files = ["/etc/passwd", "/var/log/auth.log", "/home/user/document.txt", "/etc/shadow", "/app/config.env"]

    for i in range(count):

        event_type = random.choice(["auth", "file", "privilege", "network"])

        if event_type == "auth":
            success = random.random() > 0.3
            event = logger.log_authentication(user, success, ip, method="password")
            monitor.monitor_event(event)

        elif event_type == "file":
            file_path = random.choice(files)
            success = random.random() > 0.2
            event = logger.log_file_access(user, file_path, "READ", success, ip)
            monitor.monitor_event(event)

        elif event_type == "privilege":
            roles = ["user", "admin", "root", "guest"]
            from_role = random.choice(roles)
            to_role = random.choice([r for r in roles if r != from_role])
            authorized = random.random() > 0.7
            event = logger.log_privilege_escalation(user, from_role, to_role, authorized, ip)
            monitor.monitor_event(event)

        time.sleep(0.1)
